svg.title: ERC-8004 agent identity lifecycle (Identity Registry)
svg.desc: State diagram: ERC-8004 agent identity lifecycle (Identity Registry). 6 states: Not registered, Registered, no URI, Registered with URI, wallet = owner, Wallet verified, Wallet cleared, and Declared inactive (off-chain only). Starts in Not registered. 17 transitions. From Not registered to Registered, no URI when Mint without a URI (register()). From Not registered to Registered with URI, wallet = owner when Mint with a URI (register(agentURI) or register(agentURI, metadata)). From Registered, no URI to Registered with URI, wallet = owner when Owner or operator sets the URI (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI)). From Registered with URI, wallet = owner to Registered with URI, wallet = owner when File moved or edited (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI)). From Registered with URI, wallet = owner to Wallet verified when New wallet signs AgentWalletSet within 5 minutes (setAgentWallet(agentId, newWallet, deadline, signature)). From Wallet verified to Wallet cleared when Owner or operator clears the wallet (unsetAgentWallet(agentId)). From Registered with URI, wallet = owner to Wallet cleared when Token transferred to a new owner (ERC-721 transferFrom or safeTransferFrom). From Wallet verified to Wallet cleared when Token transferred to a new owner (ERC-721 transferFrom or safeTransferFrom). From Wallet cleared to Wallet verified when Current owner binds a wallet again (setAgentWallet(agentId, newWallet, deadline, signature)). From Registered with URI, wallet = owner to Declared inactive (off-chain only) when Owner publishes a file with active false (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI) or an HTTPS file edit). From Wallet verified to Declared inactive (off-chain only) when Owner publishes a file with active false (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI) or an HTTPS file edit). From Declared inactive (off-chain only) to Registered with URI, wallet = owner when Owner publishes a file with active true (wallet state unchanged) (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI)). From Registered with URI, wallet = owner to Wallet cleared when Owner or operator clears the wallet (unsetAgentWallet(agentId)). From Registered, no URI to Wallet verified when New wallet signs AgentWalletSet (no URI needed) (setAgentWallet(agentId, newWallet, deadline, signature)). From Registered, no URI to Wallet cleared when Transfer or unset before a URI is set (ERC-721 transfer or unsetAgentWallet(agentId)). From Wallet verified to Wallet verified when Bind a different wallet (setAgentWallet(agentId, newWallet, deadline, signature)). From Wallet cleared to Declared inactive (off-chain only) when Owner publishes a file with active false (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI) or an HTTPS file edit).
